question: Should OpenClaw accept Podman agent sandboxing as a bundled official plugin in this repository, or should it live as an external ClawHub/npm plugin unless a missing core API is identified?
rationale: The existing sandbox backend seam appears sufficient, but accepting the request changes official sandbox posture, plugin packaging, dependency ownership, docs, and public SDK expectations, which automation cannot choose for maintainers.

options.title: Review bundled backend PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101358 as the candidate official Podman backend and require sandbox security, dependency, API, docs, and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: External plugin first
options.body: Ask the contributor to publish the Podman backend as an external ClawHub/npm plugin using the current SDK seam, then revisit bundling after adoption or a clear API gap.

options.title: Fold into broader backend planning
options.body: Defer this narrow backend until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/82017 settles the broader execution-backend/resource-profile direction.

recommendation.title: Review bundled backend PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101358 as the candidate official Podman backend and require sandbox security, dependency, API, docs, and upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history shows this account carrying the central sandbox registry and docs surface that this decision would extend.
